name: houdini_context
description: Bounded read of the attached Houdini scene: script_handle, revision, the open file, selection, and node cards (path, type, flags, inputs; values with include values). refs, match (glob on name and type) and radius pick the nodes; without them, the selection or the top-level nodes. Call first; pass revision to houdini_apply. quarantined: changes wait until release_quarantine with this read's revision.

refs.description: Up to 50 node or parm refs or paths.

radius.description: Neighbours of the picked nodes, 0 to 2.

include.description: values (parm values), affordances (the apply operations and node types).

if_revision.description: The changes since that revision, when the journal still holds them.

release_quarantine.description: After a failed change that could not be proven undone: the revision of the read that showed the scene, once you checked it; lifts the quarantine.
